title: Precognitive dream of the Focus magazine

tellings.quote: And there in the middle of the living room floor, just as I had dreamt, was a magazine. I picked it up. It was called Focus.

plain: In 1972, in married student housing in Berkeley, California, a man dreamed of a magazine lying on his living room floor, and the next day he found it there just as he had dreamed it. The man is Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic experience with a PhD, who tells it as his own experience: "there in the middle of the living room floor, just as I had dreamt, was a magazine. I picked it up. It was called Focus." Focus was the magazine of KQED, a public broadcaster in the San Francisco area, and Mishlove brings in the writer Eric Wargo as he tells it as a dream that saw the future, which would mean the mind can sometimes know what has not happened yet.
